description: This is a unit test class for the RetrieveResources class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests various aspects such as immutability, equals and hashCode behavior, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constructor input validation for the RetrieveResources command.

classes.name: RetrieveResourcesTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the RetrieveResources class, covering immutability, equals/hashCode, JSON conversion, and constructor validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that the RetrieveResources class is immutable and that certain dependent classes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods of RetrieveResources are correctly implemented.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating RetrieveResources with a null PolicyId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullPolicyIdString
methods.description: Ensures that creating RetrieveResources with a null PolicyId string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithInvalidPolicyId
methods.description: Ensures that creating RetrieveResources with an invalid PolicyId string throws PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullLabel
methods.description: Ensures that creating RetrieveResources with a null label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON serialization of RetrieveResources produces the expected JSON representation.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests deserialization of RetrieveResources from valid JSON and verifies the correctness of parsed values.
